# `pacvamp`

**Usage:** `pacvamp [--config <CONFIG>] [--sysroot <SYSROOT>] <SUBCOMMAND>`

**Version:** 0.1.0

**Author:** Jeff Dickey <@jdx>

- **Usage:** `pacvamp [--config <CONFIG>] [--sysroot <SYSROOT>] <SUBCOMMAND>`

## Global Flags
- **`--config <CONFIG>`** — Read this pacman.conf instead of /etc/pacman.conf
- **`--sysroot <SYSROOT>`** — Operate on an alternative root, like pacman --sysroot

## Flags
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
- **`-V --version`** — Print version
